title: Compare training and test regression errors
description: You evaluate the fitted pipeline separately on both data splits.

steps.description: You predict training and test targets with the same fitted reg_pipeline. Each prediction array corresponds to its own feature split.

steps.question: How does the code turn mean squared error into RMSE?
steps.answer: It takes the square root. RMSE means root mean squared error.

steps.description: You compute RMSE and R-squared separately for each split. Each metric compares predictions with labels from the matching split.
You print training RMSE 57.991 and test RMSE 58.889 in the recording. Their R-squared values are 0.447 and 0.345 respectively.
